policies.qual: (((kind = 'event'::text) AND planit_private.can_read_event_chat(event_id)) OR ((kind = 'direct'::text) AND ((( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid) = user_low_id) OR (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid) = user_high_id))))

((user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM events e
  WHERE ((e.id = event_access_grants.event_id) AND (e.organizer_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))))))

policies.with_check:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM events
  WHERE ((events.id = event_images.event_id) AND (events.organizer_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)))))

policies.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM event_participations p
  WHERE ((p.id = event_rejoin_requests.participation_id) AND (p.user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)))))

policies.with_check: ((organizer_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (visibility = ANY (ARRAY['public'::text, 'unlisted'::text])) AND (cancelled_at IS NULL) AND (archived_at IS NULL))

policies.qual: ((organizer_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR planit_private.can_view_event(id))

((uploaded_by = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM event_images
  WHERE (event_images.file_id = files.id))))

(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM conversations c
  WHERE (c.id = messages.conversation_id)))

(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM event_participations p
  WHERE (p.id = participation_history.participation_id)))
((( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid) = follower_id) OR (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid) = followed_id))

policies.with_check:
((bucket_id = 'event_media'::text) AND (split_part(name, '/'::text, 1) = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))::text) AND (split_part(name, '/'::text, 2) ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'::text) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM events
  WHERE (((events.id)::text = split_part(objects.name, '/'::text, 2)) AND (events.organizer_id <> ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)))))))

policies.qual:
((bucket_id = 'event_media'::text) AND ((split_part(name, '/'::text, 1) = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))::text) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM files
  WHERE ((files.bucket_name = objects.bucket_id) AND (files.storage_path = objects.name))))))

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION planit_private.record_participation_history()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
    if TG_OP = 'INSERT' then
        insert into public.participation_history(participation_id, previous_status, new_status, changed_by, reason)
        values (new.id, null, new.status, auth.uid(),
            case new.status when 'confirmed' then 'registration' when 'cancelled' then 'voluntary_leave' else 'organizer_removal' end);
    elsif old.status is distinct from new.status then
        insert into public.participation_history(participation_id, previous_status, new_status, changed_by, reason)
        values (new.id, old.status, new.status, auth.uid(),
            case when old.status = 'removed' and new.status = 'confirmed' then 'rejoin_approval'
                when new.status = 'confirmed' then 'registration' when new.status = 'cancelled' then 'voluntary_leave' else 'organizer_removal' end);
    end if;
    return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.discover_public_events(p_south double precision, p_north double precision, p_west double precision, p_east double precision)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, organizer_id uuid, title text, description text, starts_at timestamp without time zone, ends_at timestamp without time zone, address text, location_name text, latitude double precision, longitude double precision, capacity integer, category_id uuid, visibility text, cancelled_at timestamp without time zone, archived_at timestamp without time zone, category_name text, image_path text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
    select e.id, e.organizer_id, e.title, e.description, e.starts_at, e.ends_at,
        e.address, e.location_name, e.latitude, e.longitude, e.capacity,
        e.category_id, e.visibility, e.cancelled_at, e.archived_at, c.name,
        (select f.storage_path from public.event_images i
         join public.files f on f.id = i.file_id
         where i.event_id = e.id order by i.sort_order limit 1)
    from public.events e join public.categories c on c.id = e.category_id
    where (select auth.uid()) is not null
        and e.visibility = 'public' and e.cancelled_at is null and e.archived_at is null
        and e.ends_at > (statement_timestamp() at time zone 'America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires')
        and p_south between -90 and 90 and p_north between p_south and 90
        and p_west between -180 and 180 and p_east between -180 and 180
        and e.latitude between p_south and p_north
        and case when p_west <= p_east then e.longitude between p_west and p_east
                 else e.longitude >= p_west or e.longitude <= p_east end
    order by e.starts_at, e.id limit 101;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_event_attendees(p_event_id uuid, p_status text DEFAULT 'confirmed'::text, p_search text DEFAULT ''::text, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
    if auth.uid() is null then raise exception 'authentication_required' using errcode = '42501'; end if;
    if not exists (select 1 from public.events where id = p_event_id and organizer_id = auth.uid()) then
        raise exception 'event_unavailable' using errcode = '42501';
    end if;
    if p_status is null or p_status not in ('confirmed', 'removed') or p_search is null
        or char_length(p_search) > 120 or p_offset is null or p_offset < 0 then
        raise exception 'invalid_attendees_query' using errcode = '22023';
    end if;
    return (
        with page as materialized (
            select p.id as participation_id, p.user_id, p.status, case when planit_private.social_blocked(profile.id) then 'Perfil no disponible' else profile.display_name end as display_name,
                case when planit_private.social_blocked(profile.id) then '' else profile.username end as username,
                lower(case when planit_private.social_blocked(profile.id) then 'Perfil no disponible' else profile.display_name end) as sort_name
            from public.event_participations p join public.profiles profile on profile.id = p.user_id
            where p.event_id = p_event_id and p.status = p_status
                and (btrim(p_search) = '' or not planit_private.social_blocked(profile.id))
                and strpos(lower(case when planit_private.social_blocked(profile.id) then 'Perfil no disponible' else profile.display_name end), lower(btrim(p_search))) > 0
            order by lower(case when planit_private.social_blocked(profile.id) then 'Perfil no disponible' else profile.display_name end), p.id limit 31 offset p_offset
        )
        select jsonb_build_object(
            'title', e.title, 'capacity', e.capacity,
            'event_state', case when e.archived_at is not null then 'archived'
                when e.cancelled_at is not null then 'cancelled'
                when e.ends_at <= (statement_timestamp() at time zone 'America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires') then 'ended' else 'open' end,
            'confirmed_count', (select count(*) from public.event_participations where event_id = e.id and status = 'confirmed'),
            'removed_count', (select count(*) from public.event_participations where event_id = e.id and status = 'removed'),
            'pending_count', (select count(*) from public.event_rejoin_requests r join public.event_participations p on p.id = r.participation_id where p.event_id = e.id and r.status = 'pending'),
            'has_more', (select count(*) > 30 from page),
            'attendees', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(visible) - 'sort_name' order by sort_name, participation_id)
                from (select * from page order by sort_name, participation_id limit 30) visible), '[]'::jsonb)
        )
        from public.events e
        where e.id = p_event_id
    );
end;
$function$
functions.identity_arguments: p_event_id uuid, p_status text, p_search text, p_offset integer

 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, sender_id uuid, body text, created_at timestamp without time zone, display_name text, username text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql

 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
    if not planit_private.can_read_event_chat(p_event_id) then raise exception 'chat_unavailable' using errcode = '42501'; end if;
    if (p_before_at is null) <> (p_before_id is null) then raise exception 'invalid_cursor'; end if;
    return query select m.id, m.sender_id, m.body, m.created_at, p.display_name, p.username
        from public.messages m join public.conversations c on c.id = m.conversation_id
        join public.profiles p on p.id = m.sender_id where c.event_id = p_event_id
        and (p_before_at is null or (m.created_at, m.id) < (p_before_at, p_before_id))
        order by m.created_at desc, m.id desc limit 51;
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_event_participation_summary(p_event_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(confirmed_count bigint, capacity integer, available_spots bigint, own_status text, is_organizer boolean, event_state text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
    if auth.uid() is null then raise exception 'authentication_required' using errcode = '42501'; end if;
    return query
    select counts.total, e.capacity, greatest(e.capacity - counts.total, 0::bigint), own.status,
        e.organizer_id = auth.uid(),
        case when e.archived_at is not null then 'archived' when e.cancelled_at is not null then 'cancelled'
            when e.ends_at <= (statement_timestamp() at time zone 'America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires') then 'ended' else 'open' end
    from public.events e
    left join public.event_participations own on own.event_id = e.id and own.user_id = auth.uid()
    cross join lateral (select count(*) as total from public.event_participations p where p.event_id = e.id and p.status = 'confirmed') counts
    where e.id = p_event_id and planit_private.can_view_event(e.id);
    if not found then raise exception 'event_unavailable' using errcode = '42501'; end if;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_event_rejoin_requests(p_event_id uuid, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
    if auth.uid() is null then raise exception 'authentication_required' using errcode = '42501'; end if;
    if not exists (select 1 from public.events where id = p_event_id and organizer_id = auth.uid()) then raise exception 'event_unavailable' using errcode = '42501'; end if;
    if p_offset is null or p_offset < 0 then raise exception 'invalid_rejoin_query' using errcode = '22023'; end if;
    return (
        with page as materialized (
            select r.id as request_id, r.participation_id, r.status, r.requested_at, case when planit_private.social_blocked(profile.id) then 'Perfil no disponible' else profile.display_name end as display_name,
                case when planit_private.social_blocked(profile.id) then '' else profile.username end as username
            from public.event_rejoin_requests r join public.event_participations p on p.id = r.participation_id
            join public.profiles profile on profile.id = p.user_id
            where p.event_id = p_event_id and r.status = 'pending'
            order by r.requested_at desc, r.id desc limit 31 offset p_offset
        )
        select jsonb_build_object('title', e.title, 'capacity', e.capacity,
            'event_state', case when e.archived_at is not null then 'archived' when e.cancelled_at is not null then 'cancelled'
                when e.ends_at <= (statement_timestamp() at time zone 'America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires') then 'ended' else 'open' end,
            'confirmed_count', (select count(*) from public.event_participations where event_id = e.id and status = 'confirmed'),
            'pending_count', (select count(*) from public.event_rejoin_requests r join public.event_participations p on p.id=r.participation_id where p.event_id=e.id and r.status='pending'),
            'has_more', (select count(*) > 30 from page),
            'requests', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(visible) order by requested_at desc, request_id desc)
                from (select * from page order by requested_at desc, request_id desc limit 30) visible), '[]'::jsonb))
        from public.events e where e.id = p_event_id
    );
end;
$function$

 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, organizer_id uuid, title text, description text, starts_at timestamp without time zone, ends_at timestamp without time zone, address text, location_name text, latitude double precision, longitude double precision, capacity integer, category_id uuid, visibility text, cancelled_at timestamp without time zone, archived_at timestamp without time zone, category_name text, image_path text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
    select e.id, e.organizer_id, e.title, e.description,
        e.starts_at, e.ends_at, e.address, e.location_name,
        e.latitude, e.longitude, e.capacity, e.category_id,
        e.visibility, e.cancelled_at, e.archived_at, c.name,
        (select f.storage_path
         from public.event_images i
         join public.files f on f.id = i.file_id
         where i.event_id = e.id
         order by i.sort_order
         limit 1)
    from public.events e
    join public.categories c on c.id = e.category_id
    where (select auth.uid()) is not null
        and e.visibility = 'public'
        and e.cancelled_at is null
        and e.archived_at is null
        and e.starts_at > (statement_timestamp() at time zone 'America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires')
        and (
            (p_before_starts_at is null and p_before_id is null)
            or (p_before_starts_at is not null and p_before_id is not null
                and (e.starts_at, e.id) > (p_before_starts_at, p_before_id))
        )
    order by e.starts_at, e.id
    limit least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 30), 1), 100) + 1;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_events(p_section text, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, title text, starts_at timestamp without time zone, ends_at timestamp without time zone, location_name text, address text, category_name text, event_state text, participation_status text, image_path text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
    if auth.uid() is null then
        raise exception 'authentication_required' using errcode = '42501';
    end if;
    if p_section is null or p_section not in ('organizing', 'participating')
        or p_offset is null or p_offset < 0 then
        raise exception 'invalid_list_parameters' using errcode = '22023';
    end if;
    return query
    select e.id, e.title, e.starts_at, e.ends_at, e.location_name, e.address, c.name,
        case when e.archived_at is not null then 'archived'
            when e.cancelled_at is not null then 'cancelled'
            when e.ends_at <= (statement_timestamp() at time zone 'America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires') then 'ended'
            else 'open' end,
        case when p_section = 'participating' then p.status else null end, photo.storage_path
    from public.events e
    join public.categories c on c.id = e.category_id
    left join public.event_participations p on p.event_id = e.id and p.user_id = (select auth.uid())
    left join lateral (
        select f.storage_path from public.event_images i
        join public.files f on f.id = i.file_id
        where i.event_id = e.id
        order by i.sort_order limit 1
    ) photo on true
    where (p_section = 'organizing' and e.organizer_id = (select auth.uid()))
       or (p_section = 'participating' and p.user_id = (select auth.uid()) and e.organizer_id <> (select auth.uid()))
    order by e.starts_at desc, e.id
    limit 31 offset p_offset;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_organized_events(p_filter text DEFAULT 'all'::text, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, title text, starts_at timestamp without time zone, ends_at timestamp without time zone, location_name text, address text, category_name text, event_state text, participation_status text, image_path text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
    if auth.uid() is null then
        raise exception 'authentication_required' using errcode = '42501';
    end if;
    if p_filter is null or p_filter not in ('all', 'upcoming', 'past', 'cancelled', 'archived')
        or p_offset is null or p_offset < 0 then
        raise exception 'invalid_list_parameters' using errcode = '22023';
    end if;
    return query
    with own_events as (
        select e.*, case when e.archived_at is not null then 'archived'
            when e.cancelled_at is not null then 'cancelled'
            when e.ends_at <= (statement_timestamp() at time zone 'America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires') then 'ended'
            else 'open' end as state
        from public.events e
        where e.organizer_id = (select auth.uid())
    )
    select e.id, e.title, e.starts_at, e.ends_at, e.location_name, e.address, c.name,
        e.state, null::text, photo.storage_path
    from own_events e
    join public.categories c on c.id = e.category_id
    left join lateral (
        select f.storage_path from public.event_images i
        join public.files f on f.id = i.file_id
        where i.event_id = e.id
        order by i.sort_order limit 1
    ) photo on true
    where (p_filter = 'all' and e.state <> 'archived')
       or (p_filter = 'upcoming' and e.state = 'open')
       or (p_filter = 'past' and e.state = 'ended')
       or (p_filter = 'cancelled' and e.state = 'cancelled')
       or (p_filter = 'archived' and e.state = 'archived')
    order by e.starts_at desc, e.id
    limit 31 offset p_offset;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_suggested_events(p_origin_lat double precision DEFAULT NULL::double precision, p_origin_lng double precision DEFAULT NULL::double precision, p_limit integer DEFAULT 6)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, organizer_id uuid, title text, description text, starts_at timestamp without time zone, ends_at timestamp without time zone, address text, location_name text, latitude double precision, longitude double precision, capacity integer, category_id uuid, visibility text, cancelled_at timestamp without time zone, archived_at timestamp without time zone, category_name text, image_path text, has_interests boolean, matches_interest boolean, distance_km double precision, starts_soon boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
    v_user_id uuid := (select auth.uid());
    v_now timestamp := statement_timestamp() at time zone 'America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires';
    v_has_interests boolean;
begin
    if v_user_id is null then return; end if;
    if (p_origin_lat is null) <> (p_origin_lng is null)
        or (p_origin_lat is not null and not (
            p_origin_lat between -90 and 90 and p_origin_lng between -180 and 180)) then
        raise exception 'suggestions_invalid_origin' using errcode = '22023';
    end if;
    if p_limit is null or p_limit not between 1 and 20 then
        raise exception 'suggestions_invalid_limit' using errcode = '22023';
    end if;
    select exists(select 1 from public.user_category_interests i where i.user_id = v_user_id)
        into v_has_interests;

    -- All authorized available public candidates are scored BEFORE LIMIT. Own and
    -- confirmed events remain eligible. Saved inactive interests retain affinity.
    -- No-interest fallback is chronological, not disguised personalization.
    return query
    with candidates as (
        select e.*, c.name as category_name,
            exists(select 1 from public.user_category_interests i
                where i.user_id = v_user_id and i.category_id = e.category_id) as affinity,
            case when p_origin_lat is not null then
                2 * 6371 * asin(least(1, sqrt(
                    power(sin(radians(e.latitude - p_origin_lat) / 2), 2)
                    + cos(radians(p_origin_lat)) * cos(radians(e.latitude))
                    * power(sin(radians(e.longitude - p_origin_lng) / 2), 2))))
            end as distance,
            greatest(0, extract(epoch from (e.starts_at - v_now)) / 86400)::double precision as days_until
        from public.events e join public.categories c on c.id = e.category_id
        where e.visibility = 'public' and e.cancelled_at is null and e.archived_at is null
            and e.ends_at > v_now
    ), ranked as (
        select c.*, (case when c.affinity then 100 else 0 end)
            + coalesce(30 * greatest(0, 1 - c.distance / 50), 0)
            + 20 * greatest(0, 1 - c.days_until / 7) as score
        from candidates c
    ), selected as (
        select r.* from ranked r where not v_has_interests or r.score > 0
        order by case when v_has_interests then r.score else 0 end desc, r.starts_at, r.id
        limit p_limit
    )
    select s.id, s.organizer_id, s.title, s.description, s.starts_at, s.ends_at,
        s.address, s.location_name, s.latitude, s.longitude, s.capacity, s.category_id,
        s.visibility, s.cancelled_at, s.archived_at, s.category_name,
        (select f.storage_path from public.event_images i join public.files f on f.id = i.file_id
            where i.event_id = s.id order by i.sort_order limit 1),
        v_has_interests, s.affinity, s.distance, s.days_until < 7
    from selected s
    order by case when v_has_interests then s.score else 0 end desc, s.starts_at, s.id;
end;
$function$
functions.identity_arguments: p_origin_lat double precision, p_origin_lng double precision, p_limit integer

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_direct_conversations(p_before_at timestamp without time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp without time zone, p_before_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_limit integer DEFAULT 30)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare v_rows jsonb; v_more boolean;
begin
    if auth.uid() is null then raise exception 'authentication_required' using errcode = '42501'; end if;
    if p_limit is null or p_limit not between 1 and 50 or (p_before_at is null) <> (p_before_id is null) then
        raise exception 'invalid_message_cursor' using errcode = '22023';
    end if;
    -- No profile join: blocked peers' social identity must not leak via headers.
    with page as (
        select c.id, c.created_at,
            case when c.user_low_id = auth.uid() then c.user_high_id else c.user_low_id end as peer_id,
            planit_private.social_blocked(case when c.user_low_id = auth.uid() then c.user_high_id else c.user_low_id end) as read_only
        from public.conversations c where c.kind = 'direct'
            and (p_before_at is null or (c.created_at,c.id) < (p_before_at,p_before_id))
        order by c.created_at desc,c.id desc limit p_limit + 1
    ), numbered as (select *, row_number() over(order by created_at desc,id desc) as n from page)
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(numbered) - 'n' order by created_at desc,id desc)
        filter(where n <= p_limit),'[]'::jsonb),count(*) > p_limit into v_rows,v_more from numbered;
    return jsonb_build_object('conversations',v_rows,'next_cursor',case when v_more then
        jsonb_build_object('created_at',v_rows->(p_limit-1)->'created_at','id',v_rows->(p_limit-1)->'id') end);
end;
$function$
functions.identity_arguments: p_before_at timestamp without time zone, p_before_id uuid, p_limit integer

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_follow_requests(p_after_requested_at timestamp without time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp without time zone, p_after_follower_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_limit integer DEFAULT 30)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare v_rows jsonb; v_more boolean;
begin
    if auth.uid() is null then raise exception 'authentication_required' using errcode = '42501'; end if;
    if p_limit is null or p_limit not between 1 and 50 or
        (p_after_requested_at is null) <> (p_after_follower_id is null) then
        raise exception 'invalid_social_query' using errcode = '22023';
    end if;
    with page as (
        select f.follower_id, f.request_version, f.requested_at, p.display_name, p.username,
            case when p.avatar_file_id is not null then p.id end as avatar
        from public.user_follows f join public.profiles p on p.id = f.follower_id
        where f.followed_id = auth.uid() and f.status = 'pending'
            and not planit_private.social_blocked(f.follower_id)
            and (p_after_requested_at is null or
                (f.requested_at, f.follower_id) > (p_after_requested_at, p_after_follower_id))
        order by f.requested_at, f.follower_id limit p_limit + 1
    ), numbered as (select *, row_number() over(order by requested_at, follower_id) as n from page)
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(numbered) - 'n' order by requested_at, follower_id)
        filter(where n <= p_limit), '[]'::jsonb), count(*) > p_limit into v_rows, v_more from numbered;
    return jsonb_build_object('requests', v_rows, 'next_cursor', case when v_more then
        jsonb_build_object('requested_at',v_rows->(p_limit-1)->'requested_at',
            'follower_id',v_rows->(p_limit-1)->'follower_id') end);
end;
$function$
functions.identity_arguments: p_after_requested_at timestamp without time zone, p_after_follower_id uuid, p_limit integer

functions.name: list_social_follows
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_social_follows(p_user_id uuid, p_direction text, p_after_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_limit integer DEFAULT 30)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare v_rows jsonb; v_more boolean;
begin
    if not planit_private.can_read_social_content(p_user_id) then
        raise exception 'profile_unavailable' using errcode = '42501';
    end if;
    if p_direction is null or p_direction not in ('followers','following') or p_limit is null or p_limit not between 1 and 50 then
        raise exception 'invalid_social_query' using errcode = '22023';
    end if;
    with related as (
        select case when p_direction = 'followers' then f.follower_id else f.followed_id end as user_id
        from public.user_follows f where f.status = 'accepted' and
            ((p_direction = 'followers' and f.followed_id = p_user_id) or
             (p_direction = 'following' and f.follower_id = p_user_id))
    ), page as (
        select p.id as user_id, p.display_name, p.username,
            case when p.avatar_file_id is not null then p.id end as avatar
        from related r join public.profiles p on p.id = r.user_id
        where not planit_private.social_blocked(p.id) and not exists (
            select 1 from public.user_blocks b where
            (b.blocker_id = p_user_id and b.blocked_id = p.id) or
            (b.blocker_id = p.id and b.blocked_id = p_user_id))
            and (p_after_user_id is null or p.id > p_after_user_id)
        order by p.id limit p_limit + 1
    ), numbered as (select *, row_number() over(order by user_id) as n from page)
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(numbered) - 'n' order by user_id)
        filter(where n <= p_limit), '[]'::jsonb), count(*) > p_limit into v_rows, v_more from numbered;
    return jsonb_build_object('users',v_rows,'next_cursor',case when v_more then v_rows->(p_limit-1)->>'user_id' end);
end;
$function$
functions.identity_arguments: p_user_id uuid, p_direction text, p_after_user_id uuid, p_limit integer

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.unblock_user(p_target_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$

    perform planit_private.lock_social_pair(p_target_id);
    delete from public.user_blocks where blocker_id = auth.uid() and blocked_id = p_target_id;

$function$
